Problem (rule): the rule that the triage session always writes a repo's page (decision owner-feedback-inbox) has no named triage session for these three repos; the coordinator and the child-repo batch runner 12 both say they do not know one, and only you can name a writer or start one.
Based on (read): runner 12's 03:19 CST Nov 18 word, relayed by the coordinator, that it does not know the writer; triage 11's 03:17 CST word that it writes only the claude-settings page.
Based on (read): the build session (runner 11) says all three blocks built and passed, at 03:18 CST Nov 18; banchi has steps, q_max and joyous have none because their roadmap branches hold no steps (a true read, not a failure).
Departs from: main — adds a page writer for three child repos.
Waiting on: the three pages stay without a Status tab; the coordinator carries your pick to runner 11 and triage 11 acts next.
home: step roadmap-blank-pages (the Status tab of banchi, q_max and joyous)
